#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import pandas as pd

# Read the raw long‑format data
raw_path = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"
df_raw = pd.read_csv(raw_path, dtype=str)

# Create the pivot matrix
pivot = (
    df_raw
    .pivot(index=["city_id", "city_name", "year"],
           columns="indicator_id",
           values="value")
    .reset_index()
)

# Ensure header order: city_id, city_name, year, followed by indicator columns sorted alphabetically
indicator_cols = sorted(pivot.columns.drop(["city_id", "city_name", "year"]))
pivot = pivot[["city_id", "city_name", "year"] + indicator_cols]

# Write out in RFC 4180 compliant form (minimal quoting)
output_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
pivot.to_csv(output_path, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>
